message: No detected input validation: The get_data function reads CSV files directly without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards beyond a single hardcoded dtype for 'Special' column.

No detected untrusted source handling: Images are loaded from external URLs (pixabay, streamlit.io, etc.) and CSV files are read from local paths without any checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code only drops certain columns and applies standard imputation/scaling; there are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms to defend against poisoned training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The serialized model is loaded from a path (FILENAME_MODEL = PATH+'optimized_model.sav') using pickle without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision validation.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label set, or anomalous sample distribution before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection implemented anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanism is used; training uses a plain LGBMClassifier with cross_validate.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress tests are referenced or implemented anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no isolation mechanism for a held-out test set, no signed or hashed evaluation data, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; the test set (application_test.csv) appears to be unlabeled and used only for inference, with no protected evaluation protoco
No detected input sanitization: Client IDs are taken directly from a selectbox or text_input with no shape, range, or schema validation before being used for inference.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is visible that checks model prediction outputs for NaN values, probability bounds, or calibrated thresholds before displaying results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a LightGBM tabular classifier, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
